argv:
# Task

Take a person's full name and pull out the initial of each part of
it. The parts of a name are separated by spaces.

Give them back as a sequence of single upper-case characters, one per
part, in the order the parts appear.

Write the code in a file called `solution.py` in this directory.
Nothing else is needed and nothing else is read.
